These are just a few possible ways that your role as a protector and provider might shape your decision-making style. It's essential to recognize that these influences can be both strengths and weaknesses, depending on the context and situation. By acknowledging the influences of your role as a protector and provider, you can become a more effective and intentional decision-maker, better equipped to navigate the complexities of life and make choices that benefit your family and yourself.
